decision: Endorse Module H as the route for Industrial Connectivity and FleetView (five families), using the IEC 62443-4-1 process as the base.
Apply the stricter reading to EG-700 and HomeHub H3 until the legal opinion lands on 27 Nov 2026: include them in notified-body capacity planning, keep them in Wave 2 for remediation.
Release EUR 0.75m of pre-approval spend ahead of the 19 Nov board.
Approve the Project Rampart investment envelope.
detail: EUR 9.3m one-off to Dec 2027 (incl. 15% contingency) and EUR 1.8m a year run from 2028.

decision: Appoint the accountable executive and execute the DoC signing instrument.
detail: CTO as accountable executive; CEO signs declarations or delegates in writing; compliance lead counter-signs the pre-signature checklist.
Pre-assessments with three candidate bodies (up to EUR 60k) and formal contracts by Q1 2027 (Module H for IC + FleetView; Module B+C for V1 and L2).
Cost, risk appetite and commercial strategy are not grounds to leave product risk unaddressed (guidance paras 156-163); appeals go to the executive sponsor.

decision: Withdraw IR-300 and IS-200 from EU sale before 11 Dec 2027.
detail: EUR 18m of declining EU revenue versus about EUR 1.4m remediation plus notified-body fees; migrate customers to IR-500 and IS-300.
